title: Efficient solar-driven hydrogen peroxide production enabled by a perovskite electrochemical device integrated with a cobalt-based chiral catalyst
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,312-326
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04313A, Paper
Young Sun Park, Jaerim Kim, Subin Moon, Eunji Ahn, Hyeonwoong Hwang, Sang-Hoon You, Juwon Lee, Chang-Seop Jeong, Wooyong Jeong, Hyoung-il Kim, Yong-Tae Kim, Kug-Seung Lee, Donghwa Lee, Jong Kyu Kim, Jooho Moon
Efficient H2O2 production was achieved on chiral Co NH catalyst, enhancing 2e− ORR by removing oxygen intermediate. A Co NH decorated perovskite cathode showed −18 mA cm−2 at 1.2 VRHE, and when paired with an IOR catalyst, delivered 9.4% SCC.
